About

A.

Amira Fares works at the intersection of artificial intelligence and machine learning, building systems that turn raw data into working solutions.

Her focus spans deep learning, computer vision, and data analysis — using tools like Python, R, TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-learn to move projects from an idea to something that runs, from tracking players on a football pitch to reading a chest X-ray.

Every project starts the same way: understand the problem first, then choose the technology that fits it — not the other way around.

Projects

A selection of AI and machine learning work across sport, healthcare, and data.

Computer Vision · Sports Analytics

AI-Powered Football Player Tracking

A computer vision system that tracks football players in real time during matches, using deep learning to support sports analytics and broadcasting. It analyzes player movement to give teams and broadcasters clearer insight into match play, tactics, and viewer engagement.

Deep Learning · Medical Imaging

Pneumonia Detection System

A deep learning model that classifies chest X-ray images to detect pneumonia with high accuracy. Built on convolutional neural networks trained on X-ray datasets, it supports faster, AI-assisted diagnosis to help clinicians act sooner.

Systems · Healthcare

Hospital Management System

A system built to help organize hospital operations and patient information, aimed at making day-to-day healthcare administration more efficient and easier to track.
